items.title: Example of Lamarckism: Evolution of giraffe neck (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Example of Lamarckism: Evolution of giraffe neck: a main subheading of Lamarck's Theory and the Giraffe, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 224-224.

blocks.text: Lamarckism ko sabit karne ke liye aksar zarafe ki gardan ki misaal di jati hai. Zarafe ke buzurgon ki gardanein lambi nahin thin. Woh ghaas ya chhote paudon ke patte khate the. Mahol mein tabdeeli aayi aur chhote paude unhein milna band ho gaye. Nayi soorat-e-haal mein population ke kuch afraad ne mutabadil (alternative) ke taur par oonche darakhton ke patton tak pohanchne ke liye apni gardanein khenchna shuru kar diya. Jab woh musalsal aisa karte rahe to apni zindagi hi mein un ki gardanein mazboot aur lambi ho gayin. Yeh ek acquired character tha. Jab in afraad ne bachche paida kiye to yeh acquired character agli nasl mein muntaqil hua, yaani naye bachche thori lambi gardan ke saath paida hue. Bare ho kar unhon ne bhi gardan khenchne ki wahi aadat jari rakhi. Is tarah un ki gardanein aur bhi mazboot aur lambi ho gayin, aur yeh phir ek acquired character bana. Jab yeh acquired character bohat si naslon tak muntaqil hota raha to lambi gardan wali nasl wujood mein aa gayi.

blocks.alt: Teen rangeen hisson mein chaar zarafe, oopar pattedaar shakhein. Short-necked ancestor: chhoti gardan wala zarafa jo shakh tak nahi pohanchta. Necks became long as a result of stretching: lambi gardan wala zarafa patton tak khinchta hua. Acquired characters passed to next generations: aur lambi gardanon wale do zarafe oonchi shakhon tak. Surkh teer aik se agle zarafe tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.8: Zarafe ki gardan ka irtiqa, Lamarckism ke mutabiq (kitab ki Figure 24.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Lamarck ki tarteeb yaad rakhein: zaroorat → istemal (gardan khenchna) → zindagi mein tabdeeli (acquired character) → bachchon mein muntaqil → naslon ke baad lambi gardan. Aaj ki science ke mutabiq teesra qadam (acquired character ka bachchon mein jana) ghalat hai.

blocks.prompt: Darwin zarafe ki lambi gardan ke bare mein Lamarck ke bajaye kya kehte?
blocks.explanation: Ke zarafon ki gardan ki lambai mein paidaish hi se farq (variation) tha; lambi gardan wale zarafe oonche patte kha kar zyada zinda rahe aur zyada bachche paida kiye, is liye naslon ke saath yeh khasiyat aam ho gayi (natural selection). Gardan khenchne se hasil hui lambai bachchon mein nahin jati.

items: Use and disuse: zyada istemal hone wale aaza mazboot, kam istemal hone wale kamzor; aisi tabdeeliyan acquired characters.
Inheritance of acquired characters: zindagi mein hasil khasiyatein bachchon mein jati hain (Lamarck ka khayal).
Zarafe ki misaal: gardan khenchne se lambi gardan, jo naslon tak muntaqil ho kar lambi gardan wali nasl bani.
